name: Heartbreak Detour
source:
You travel from out of town to Heart City, to confess your love to your crush, Grace. Unfortunately for you, she panics at your sudden arrival and rejects you right at her front door. That's… not exactly the ideal outcome for someone inexperienced in love. Heartbroken, you're left confused and lost.

A chance encounter leads you to Sooha, a bubbly girl from your university days. She offers to help you build courage and confidence by diving headfirst into the unpredictable adventures the city has to offer. Her plan isn't perfect, but given your inexperience, it's the best shot you have at gaining your confidence and winning Grace's heart!

Following her lead, you embark on a new adventure filled with love lessons, bar conversations, new friends, spicy women(?!), and perhaps... a few bad decisions. But will your heart stay loyal to your plan, or wander into the unexpected? 

[From [url=https://parkedhearts.itch.io/heartbreak-detour-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
